name: TMCNE
description: TMCNE (TMC + CNE), also known as the "30Boyz," is a northwest Detroit-based criminal street gang operating primarily within the 48235 ZIP code. The group is also designated as TMCG/8624. It has documented associations with 24CashGang (FWC/392), a Crip-aligned group connected to the Rollin 60s Neighborhood Crips, and is listed as a rival of the Rollin 20s Crips (Detroit).

sources.title: Understanding Hybrid and Mixed-Affiliation Groups in Metro Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
